 AMAZING SEAFOOD AND COLD DRINKSevery day!
 Kick back and enjoy fresh seafood and live music in The Hangout Courtyard every night! As your servers and bartenders serve delicious dishes and perfectly crafted cocktails, the nightly performances provide a perfect backdrop for unforgettable evenings on the island!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FREE LIVE MUSIC IN GULF SHORES
 
 
 SEE SCHEDULE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 FREE LIVE MUSIC IN MYRTLE BEACH
 
 
 SEE SCHEDULE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Continuous Fun
 FOR THE ENTIRE FAMILY!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Free Foam Parties Every Hour!
 Dive into mountains of frothy fun at our family-friendly foam parties. Every hour the foam party starts, creating a bubbly wonderland for kids (and adults!) to play in. Cool down and have some unforgettable fun at The Hangout!

 
 GULF SHORES INFO
 MYRTLE BEACH INFO
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We Love Large Parties!
 The Hangout is never short on ample space and a lively atmosphere for your large party. Our staff goes above and beyond to accommodate groups of any size, ensuring a memorable dining experience for your celebration or gathering!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Celebrate Your Birthday!
 We celebrate birthdays every hour. If you’re soaking up the sun in sand in Gulf Shores or Myrtle Beach we are making memories with you.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Dancing!
 At The Hangout it’s all about fun-filled entertainment, so we welcome you to kick up your heels and move your feet to the beat! You can be sure we will have everyone clapping along and rolling on the floor laughing at dad dancing in no time!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Free Yard Games Every Day!
 In addition to enjoying live music every night, our courtyard is full of fun. Hair braiding, temporary tattoos, gelato, ring toss, photo ops, foam parties, a fire pit, and so on! Around here the activities never stop!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Make a Wish on our Wish Wall!
 Hangout’s version of a message in a bottle – write a wish down, put it in the wall! Our only wish is that all your wishes come true!

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 World Famous Collection Walls: Matchbox Cars, Pez Dispensers, Vintage Lunch Boxes, & Rubber Duckies
 Did you know we also showcase an impressive collection of antique matchbox cars, PEZ dispensers, vintage lunch boxes, and more? Our unique haven of nostalgia adds an extra layer of charm and fun to your dining experience at The Hangout.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 One Stop Fun Shop
 A treasure trove of unique and fun souvenirs, stylish beachwear or hats, and more, you can browse for gifts while waiting for your table or after enjoying your meal. Whether you’re looking to spot the perfect memento or a last-minute gift, the One Stop Fun Shop has something for everyone.

 
 
 
 
 
 and even more!!
